Every one of the skill's four actions (read/extract, add source, generate Studio output, create notebook) depends on reaching this live Google service and authenticating as a logged-in user, which also implies needs_credentials_or_account as a secondary blocker. Since this is a browser-automation skill with no offline-capable core deliverable (unlike e.g. a document-processing skill with a scriptable fallback), there is no partial task instance that exercises the stated intent without both network access and a browser-automation tool.
